title: RSOC Content Drift Manifest
description: Array of Sentinel/workbook content items tracked for drift by Invoke-ContentDriftRemediation.ps1. Each entry describes one deployed resource by its logical name, type, ARM resource ID, and canonical content body.

name.description: Logical display name of the content item. Used as the ARM resource name in GET/PUT calls.

type.description: Content resource type. Determines the ARM API path used for drift detection and remediation.

armId.description: Full ARM resource ID, if known. Used for audit/evidence logging. Not required for drift checks (the script constructs the URI from type + name).

content.description: The canonical ARM resource body used for drift comparison and remediation PUT. If absent, drift detection only reports presence/absence — it cannot compare properties or remediate.

kind.description: Alert rule kind (e.g. Scheduled, NRT, Fusion). Required for analyticsRule.

properties.description: Resource-type-specific properties block. Compared against the deployed resource during drift detection.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this item does. Used in reports only.

owner.description: Team or person responsible for authoritative content for this item.

deployedByScript.description: Name of the onboarding script that originally deployed this item.

lastVerifiedUtc.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful drift check for this item.
